title: Ex14 - Code: Joyplot iris
text:
Using the iris dataset (dfIris), create a joyplot showing distributions of 'sepal.width' and 'petal.length' per variety (Setosa, Versicolor, Virginica) using joypy.joyplot().

Note: install joypy first with pip install joypy.
answer:
import joypy
fig, axes = joypy.joyplot(dfIris, by='variety', column=['sepal.width','petal.length'], ylim='own', legend=True)
